# Configuration

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/config-reference.mjs from runner/config/01-settings.sh and the
     derivation tables in runner/config/*.sh. Do not edit by hand. CI runs
     `node scripts/config-reference.mjs --check`; regenerate with the same command
     without the flag. -->

A factory has fourteen settings, and everything else follows from them. Most people set
three: `GAFFER_MODE`, a budget (`GAFFER_DAILY_BUDGET_USD` or `GAFFER_BUDGET_USD`) and
`GAFFER_MODELS`. Set one in the dashboard (Settings), in `$GAFFER_DATA/settings.json`,
or as an environment variable; the environment wins over the file, and the file over
the default. An unknown value stops the runner with a message naming the accepted ones.

| Setting | Values | Default | What it decides |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GAFFER_MODE` | `supervised` · `lite` · `graduated` · `autonomous` · `strict` | `supervised` | Who approves and merges agent work: supervised (a person approves every merge), lite (trivial work is approved by the reviewer agent, a person merges), graduated (only what each repository earned ships on its own), autonomous (agents approve, merge and push inside the OS sandbox), strict (autonomous, and the sandbox wraps the agent even under the environment opt-out). |
| `GAFFER_DAILY_BUDGET_USD` | dollars, or empty | _none_ | The most the factory may spend in one UTC day, in dollars; empty is no daily cap. A live run needs this or GAFFER_BUDGET_USD. |
| `GAFFER_BUDGET_USD` | dollars, or empty | _none_ | The most the factory may spend in its lifetime (the whole usage ledger), in dollars; empty is no lifetime cap. |
| `GAFFER_MODELS` | `standard` · `economy` · `strong` or `strong,standard,cheap` | `standard` | The three models, as "strong,standard,cheap" (each a model id), or a preset: standard (opus,sonnet,haiku), economy (sonnet,sonnet,haiku: the strong tier moves to sonnet; implementation and review stay on sonnet), strong (opus,opus,sonnet). |
| `GAFFER_EFFORT` | `small` · `standard` · `large` | `standard` | How much work one ticket may take: small, standard or large (time per agent call, turns, delivery attempts, gate and CI time). |
| `GAFFER_CONCURRENCY` | 1 to 64 | `1` | How many tickets the factory delivers at once (1 to 64). |
| `GAFFER_SANDBOX` | `auto` · `docker` · `sandbox-exec` | `auto` | Which OS sandbox contains every agent: auto (sandbox-exec on macOS, else docker), docker or sandbox-exec. Running with none is only the environment opt-out GAFFER_STRICT_REQUIRE=0. |
| `GAFFER_GATES` | `standard` · `strict` (or a list, environment only) | `standard` | The Definition-of-Done gates: standard (tests, lint and typecheck must pass) or strict (also a smallest-change note, tighter size flags, no flaky rerun). In the environment only, a list such as "tests,lint" runs only those. |
| `GAFFER_LANDING` | `local` · `pr` | `local` | How approved work lands: local (merged into the default branch of the repository on this machine) or pr (a pull request per delivery: it enters review once its checks are green, and an approved one is merged through the pull request). |
| `GAFFER_TESTING` | `auto` · `on` · `off` | `auto` | The independent tester lane: auto (on where a repository has a test command), on (every testable ticket) or off (only the acceptance ticket of an epic). |
| `GAFFER_IDLE` | `auto` · `off` · `maintenance` · `backlog` · `all` | `auto` | What the factory does when nothing is ready: auto (the Idle loops page decides), off, maintenance, backlog (plan the next feature) or all (also clarify and draft tickets). |
| `GAFFER_NOTIFY` | URLs and/or `desktop` | _none_ | Where to tell a person: a webhook URL, a Slack incoming-webhook URL and/or "desktop", separated by commas or spaces; empty sends nothing. |
| `GAFFER_DATA` | a path (environment only) | `$GAFFER_HOME/.gaffer` | Where the factory keeps its state (databases, logs, settings.json). Environment only: settings.json lives inside it. |
| `DISPATCH_API_PORT` | a port | `8787` | The port the dashboard serves on. |

`gaffer config show` prints the fourteen with their values and where each came from;
`--all` adds every value they derive and what decided it; `--json` prints both as JSON.

## Credentials and environment-only names

These are never settings: settings.json cannot set them, only the environment the runner
starts in. The worker provider is a security boundary with its own page
([worker-providers.md](worker-providers.md)); the sandbox opt-out and the uncapped switch
are in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

| Variable | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | _(empty)_ | An API key for the worker CLI (`claude`). |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` | _(empty)_ | The subscription token `claude setup-token` prints, used instead of an API key. |
| `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` | `$HOME/.claude` | Where the worker CLI keeps its login (`.credentials.json`); preflight looks there for a credential. |
| `GAFFER_PRINCIPAL_TOKEN` | _(empty)_ | A person's credential: makes `gaffer wg` act as a human or admin principal (a tester verdict needs one). |
| `GAFFER_HOME` | _computed_ (`$(cd "$RUNNER_DIR/.." && pwd)`) | the Gaffer checkout (the directory above runner/) |
| `GAFFER_STRICT_REQUIRE` | `1` | 1 (the default, in every mode) = every agent launch runs inside the OS sandbox or is refused (fail closed): `gaffer run`, the loop, a tick and the dashboard's Poll for work refuse before claiming anything, with the fix. |
| `GAFFER_ALLOW_UNCAPPED` | _(empty)_ | 1 = let a live run start with neither GAFFER_DAILY_BUDGET_USD nor GAFFER_BUDGET_USD set (default: refuse; dry runs are never refused) |
| `GAFFER_WORKER_PROVIDER` | `claude-code` | which worker runs agent turns: claude-code (headless `claude -p`, guarded by the in-process safety hook) or command (your own program at GAFFER_WORKER_COMMAND, under the contract in docs/worker-providers.md; it has no… |
| `GAFFER_WORKER_COMMAND` | _(empty)_ | absolute path of the worker program GAFFER_WORKER_PROVIDER=command runs, with no arguments, in the call's working directory; it must live outside $GAFFER_DATA and every write root and not be writable by its group or… |
| `GAFFER_WORKER_COMMAND_ENV` | _(empty)_ | space-separated env var names the command worker also receives (its own model credential, for example); the scrub drops them otherwise. |
| `GAFFER_WORKER_COMMAND_COST_USD` | _(empty)_ | the least each command-worker call is booked at in the usage ledger, in USD, because the cost it reports is its own word: a cost it leaves out or reports lower is booked at this floor (cost_basis floor). |
| `GAFFER_SANDBOX_WORKER_COMMAND` | _(empty)_ | where the command worker's program lives INSIDE the docker sandbox image; empty = the same path as GAFFER_WORKER_COMMAND (the runner dir is mounted read-only at its host path, so a program kept under it works as is). |
| `CLAUDE_BIN` | `claude` | headless `claude -p` |
| `CLAUDE_FLAGS` | `--permission-mode acceptEdits` | tune to your Claude Code version |

---

environment: [Detailed configuration](CONFIG-ADVANCED.md).
